messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] release status?
parts:
Yup, we're as bad as everyone else at forecasting the perfect
storm of compiler bugs (I'm looking at you, old version of Intel),
Windows complications (just about everything we try to do), and R
complications (BH updating to Boost 1.58 and CRAN requirements).

As of now, the timing for 2.7 is "when it's done." Our technicians
are working on it full time. We hope it's soon, but aren't promising
anything.

If anyone wants to see what we're working on, track the 2.7.0
milestone in GitHub or our discussions of the release here.

- Bob
